status: Released for printing as one complete set of four parts for the measured 13.35 mm square tube. Same mechanism, fits and hardware as R004 with about a third of the material. Geometry checks pass; physical fit, grip and print accuracy are unverified.
approval: On 2026-11-03 the user asked to cut material and print time while keeping the design generally as it is (relayed by the coordinator).

source.commit: The commit that adds this checkpoint.

clamp-u.stl.part: Clamp U with the dovetail tongue, for the 13.35 mm square tube
clamp-u.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end, tube opening vertical, dovetail tongue on the back; as exported.

clamp-bar.stl.orientation: Flat, with the four screw-head recesses facing up; as exported.

enclosure-back.stl.part: Enclosure back: frame plate, dovetail channel with a 45 degree chamfer, PCA9685 wing and tie tab
enclosure-back.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end; as exported. Add a 5 mm brim.

pi-carrier.stl.part: Pi carrier: rail frame with four standoffs on the Pi 5 hole pattern
pi-carrier.stl.orientation: Flat, standoffs facing up; as exported.

changes_from_r004: Clamp 40 mm tall instead of 50, base 4 mm instead of 6, arms 9 mm instead of 10, bar 6 mm instead of 8; bolt rows at 9 and 31 mm.

Enclosure back: 3 mm frame plate sized to the Pi board, with windows between rails through the Pi screw rows; channel walls 4 mm instead of 5; a 45 degree chamfer under the dovetail block, so no supports; case lips removed; PCA9685 wing shortened to its bosses, with a window.
Pi carrier (four standoffs on a rail frame) instead of the community case, holding the Pi at the same 7.5 mm.
kept_from_r004: 0.4 mm tube clearance per side and the 1.5 mm bar take-up
0.3 mm dovetail clearance and the tongue shape
nut slots and blind M3 holes
M2.5 x 16 Pi screws into the AI HAT+ spacers
PCA9685 position and M2.5 x 6 screws

estimate.method: Not sliced; the Snapmaker Orca command line crashed with the U1 profiles. Per part: side area x walls x 0.45 mm plus flat area x top/bottom layers x 0.2 mm, capped at the solid volume, plus infill in the rest; PETG at 1.27 g/cm3. Time at an average 6 to 10 mm3/s, as on a fast printer such as the U1. R004 is estimated the same way at its own settings (4 walls, 5 layers, 40 % infill).

hardware.check: validate() fits M3 screws from 13.7 to 16.7 mm on a 13.35 mm tube

hardware.item: M3 hex nut, 5.5 mm across flats
hardware.use: 4 in the U side slots, 1 on the lock pin

hardware.item: M3 x 40 mm screw (35 mm also fits)
hardware.use: Lock pin through the 30.6 mm enclosure block
Front face of the enclosure back, through the carrier standoffs and the Pi, into the AI HAT+ spacers

hardware.item: M2.5 x 16 mm spacer, supplied with the AI HAT+ [@raspberrypi2024AiHatBrief]
hardware.use: Pi to AI HAT+; assumed threaded at both ends
PCA9685 into the printed 2.4 mm pilots

hardware.item: Zip tie, up to 4.8 mm wide
hardware.use: Wire bundle through the tie-tab slots

measure_before_printing: Tube: square, 12.5 to 14 mm per side (measured 13.35 mm).
Bare tube: 40 mm for the clamp, with nothing fixed to any of its four faces.
Space: the mount is 104 mm tall, 81 mm wide and 80 mm deep; it hangs behind the tube from 17.5 mm below the clamp to 46.5 mm above it.

envelope_mm.frame: Clamp frame: origin on the tube axis at the clamp lower end; tube faces at +/-6.675.

interfaces.tube: 13.35 mm square tube; 0.4 mm clearance at the sides and back; the bar closes a 1.5 mm gap at the front
interfaces.dovetail: Tongue root 16, tip 22, depth 6, height 40; mates the enclosure back channel (0.3 mm clearance)
interfaces.pi: Pi 5 board underside 7.5 mm behind the plate on the carrier standoffs, as on the R004 case

overhangs: Checked on the exported meshes: the enclosure back has only 45 degree chamfers, small holes and bridges up to 22 mm; the other parts have only small holes or none.
robot_clearance: Not assessed. Only the mount size (envelope_mm) and the bare tube length are given.
not_established: tube size: one measurement of a flat side
printed dimensions, the tube and dovetail fits, the nut slots and the M2.5 threads in the PCA9685 bosses
strength of the lighter parts and settings, the clamp grip, and the lock pin under robot motion
Motor HAT spacer height (11 mm estimated) and the AI HAT+ spacer threads
wiring: drawn schematically; cable lengths and the bundle route
print time and filament: estimated, not sliced
